description: This file defines a 'Card' UI component for an Android application, which includes methods and classes to build, configure, and manage visual elements, actions, and progress indicators in a card-based UI pattern.

classes.name: Card
classes.description: A UI component representing a customizable card with optional title, description, actions, progress indicators, and visual states. Supports actions and animated state changes.

classes.name: Card.CardAction
classes.description: Represents an action button within a Card, with label, id, type, and associated view.

classes.name: Card.CardProgress
classes.description: Encapsulates progress state and UI components for a Card, supporting different progress indicator types and labels.

classes.name: Card.Builder
classes.description: Builder pattern class for constructing and inflating Card instances with specified properties and views.

methods.name: createShallowClone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the Card object without Views, useful for state preservation.

methods.name: prepareForConfigurationChange
methods.description: Nullifies view references to support configuration changes like device rotation.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the visual state of the Card, updating overlays and animations accordingly.

methods.name: setProgressType
methods.description: Configures the type of progress indicator shown on the Card.

methods.name: setProgress
methods.description: Sets current progress value for the Card's progress indicator.

methods.name: setMaxProgress
methods.description: Sets maximum value for the progress indicator.

methods.name: setProgressLabel
methods.description: Sets the label text associated with the progress indicator.

methods.name: setProgressVisibility
methods.description: Shows or hides the progress section of the Card.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Adds an action button to the Card during building.

methods.name: setActionVisibility
methods.description: Shows or hides a specific action button.

methods.name: setActionAreaVisibility
methods.description: Animates visibility toggle of the entire action area.
